code.originalText: Review the morning after a seven-day fast, before the first meal: refeeding risk assessment and start of refeeding

text.paragraph: Morning after a seven-day fast; refeeding risk assessment before the first meal. [S]

Mr. Gandhi ended his seven-day fast last night and came in this morning before eating, as agreed. During the fast he drank about 2 L a day of water with a little salt and citrus juice, held amlodipine as planned, and rested, walking only short distances. The nurse called him each day. His home sitting systolic pressure ran from 118 to 132; on the last two days he felt lightheaded when he first stood, without falling. He has had no chest pain, palpitations, vomiting, or confusion. He is weak and tired, and his clothes are loose. He has lost 2.8 kg. He wants to refeed at home with his community rather than in hospital, understanding the risks. [S]

list.item:
High risk of refeeding problems after a seven-day fast (R63.6). High risk by NICE criteria: BMI 16.0 (below 18.5) and little or no intake for more than five days. Pre-feeding sodium 136, potassium 3.7 mmol/L, phosphate 3.0 and magnesium 1.9 mg/dL are normal, which does not lower the risk. Glucose 66 mg/dL, bicarbonate 20 mmol/L, and beta-hydroxybutyrate 3.2 mmol/L show expected fasting ketosis; creatinine 0.95 mg/dL (eGFR 86); albumin 3.8 g/dL. [S]
Thiamine 100 mg three times daily, first dose now before the first meal, for 10 days.
A once-daily over-the-counter multivitamin and mineral tablet for 10 days.
Start at about 10 kcal/kg a day (about 440 kcal) in small feeds, rising to full needs of about 30 kcal/kg over 4 to 7 days, by the dietitian's written plan.
Prophylactic potassium chloride 20 mEq daily, phosphate one tablet twice daily, and magnesium oxide 400 mg daily during refeeding.
Electrolytes daily on refeeding days 2 and 3 by home blood draw, and a clinic review on day 4.
Call or come in for swelling, breathlessness, palpitations, weakness, or confusion.

Hypertension (I10). 112/68 mmHg off amlodipine, with a 14 mmHg fall on standing. [S]
Keep amlodipine on hold until sitting systolic pressure is above 130 without dizziness on standing.

Vitamin B12 deficiency (E53.8). On replacement for four weeks. [S]
Continue vitamin B12.
